items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I think Sadie was playing there. ... Not Sadie, Sadie's sister. I always get them mixed up with Sadie.

ctx.x: In that fire, yeah. That was just since Christmas.
I could have went back there but after I got sick I didn't worry about it anymore. I think Sadie was playing there. D.D.
